name: More 2024 spells
blurb: The 2024 spells the free rules leave out: the rest of the Player’s Handbook, plus Heroes of Faerûn, Forge of the Artificer, Arcana Unleashed and World of Warcraft.
contents: 174 spells: World of Warcraft (69), Player’s Handbook (52), Arcana Unleashed (33), Heroes of Faerûn (19), Forge of the Artificer (1)
Each has its level, school, casting time, range, components, duration and class lists, so players can add them to their sheets
Damage types, saving throws, conditions and areas, with the book and page for the full rules
23 of the World of Warcraft spells belong to its Death Knight and Demon Hunter classes, so no class here lists them: they’re in the spell reference
about: Stat lines from your spell data of 21 November 2026. The rules text isn’t included: each spell names the book and page that has it.
